explication: This is an OpenCode authentication and model-routing plugin for Antigravity and Gemini CLI. The main workflow starts with OpenCode loading the plugin and its configuration, then authenticating a Google account, selecting account and quota routes, preparing model-specific requests, and returning responses. The README also documents recovery, search grounding, thinking models, multi-account rotation, and update checks. Edges are limited to relationships visible in excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, or README statements; unsampled internals are represented without asserting unverified calls.
